description: Delivered enterprise-grade IBM BPM / BAW solutions in the banking sector, covering the complete implementation lifecycle from BPMN process modeling to production deployment.

Worked on multiple banking workflow automations including remittance processing, account opening, paperless account opening, inward processing, cashier cheque issuance, network access forms, and Branch Management System (BMS) enhancements.
Integrated external systems using SOAP and REST APIs, built dynamic user interfaces using Coaches and Coach Views, and optimized workflow performance to meet SLAs and business KPIs.
Worked on automation and application development initiatives including Google Sheets automation for financial management, with data processing and storage for reporting and analysis.
Developed Python-based web scraping tools for structured data extraction and integrated Google Sheets with WhatsApp and Discord to deliver automated reminders and notification messages.
Built cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and partially developed a Unity-based cricket game, integrating it with an office attendance system to support internal tracking and engagement.
Designed and implemented core gameplay mechanics for multiple mobile games using Unity (C#), including enhancements to classic games such as Pac-Man and Snake.
Developed a clown-based game featuring a structured leveling system and led performance optimization efforts to reduce load times and improve overall user experience.
Integrated Firebase Analytics to track player engagement and implemented cross-platform multiplayer functionality using Unity Networking and Firebase Realtime Database.
Developed and maintained cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter for Android and iOS platforms.
Implemented scalable state management using Provider, GetX, and Riverpod, and integrated REST APIs for efficient backend communication.

Contributed to multiple projects including Bachat Mart, car pooling applications, TikTok-style video feed cloning, and website design and development, with a focus on clean UI/UX, performance optimization, and responsive design.
